original_query: An outdoor front view of a turtle that is sitting on a floating tree trunk that has moss growing at the front of it. The turtle is yellow and green and has a dark green shell. The turtle is pointing his head up and soaking up the sun. On the water, there are a couple pieces of foam floating in the swamp. In the far background, there are multiple dried pieces of grass. On the far left side of the swamp, there is a fallen tree trunk that has moss on it.
